items.titleEn: The Danish parliament approved the agreement with Trump on Greenland.
items.summaryEn: The Danish parliament unanimously approved a security agreement with the United States on Greenland on Thursday, 28 October. Copenhagen hopes this move will restrain the future of the polar island, which has strained relations between the two sides of the Atlantic.
